en.headline: Longsys H shares open at issue price on Hong Kong debut
en.dek: Shenzhen memory-chip maker Jiangbolong listed as 09976 at HK$236 a share after a public offer about 40 times subscribed, and opened flat before slipping a little.
body: Shenzhen Jiangbolong Electronics, which trades as Longsys, began dealings in Hong Kong on Tuesday after pricing its H-share offer at HK$236, below the HK$240.60 cap set in the prospectus. The stock opened at the issue price and later traded a little below that level.

Exchange data showed the Hong Kong public offer was about 40 times subscribed, with a 2.85 per cent allotment rate for one lot of 50 shares. The company said net proceeds from the listing were about HK$6.80 billion. It already trades in Shenzhen and mainland financial reports described the dual listing as the first by an independent memory-chip firm.

Cornerstone investors named in the offering documents included Transsion, Lenovo, Lens Technology, Colorful and a TCL-linked vehicle. The company said proceeds would go mainly towards research on higher-end memory used in artificial intelligence, controller chips, and packaging and testing.

zh.headline: 江波龍港股掛牌平開報236元
zh.dek: 深圳存儲器廠商江波龍今日以09976代號在港上市，發售價每股236元，公開發售約超購40倍，開市報發行價後輕微低水。
body: 深圳江波龍電子今日在香港掛牌，H股發售價定為每股236元，低於招股文件所列上限240.6元。股份以發行價開出，其後輕微低於發行價買賣。
交易所資料顯示，香港公開發售約獲超額認購40倍，每手50股的一手中籤率為2.85%。公司表示，上市所得款項淨額約68.03億港元。江波龍已在深圳上市，內地財經報道指其為首家以「A+H」兩地上市的獨立存儲器企業。
招股文件所列基石投資者包括傳音、聯想、藍思科技、七彩虹及與TCL相關的投資工具。公司表示，所得款項主要用於人工智能高端存儲器研發、主控芯片，以及封裝測試。
